name: shred
summary: Overwrite files to make data recovery harder.
description: Overwrites file contents repeatedly and optionally removes the file; effectiveness depends on the storage medium and filesystem.

options.description: Overwrite NUMBER times instead of the default.
Add a final overwrite with zeros.

examples.title: Overwrite a temporary file
examples.explanation: Performs three overwrite passes while retaining the file.

examples.title: Overwrite and remove
examples.explanation: Overwrites and then unlinks the file.

examples.title: Finish with zeros
examples.explanation: Adds a zero pass before removal to make the result less conspicuous.

warnings: shred destroys file contents permanently; journaling, copy-on-write, and SSD wear-leveling can still leave copies that shred cannot reach.
